WellPoint failed to implement adequate security safeguards on an online application tracker database, leaving over 612,000 applicants' PHI accessible over the Internet without authentication. Affinity returned multiple leased photocopiers to a leasing company without wiping the hard drives, which contained hundreds of thousands of electronic patient records. OCR reached its first settlement involving a breach affecting fewer than 500 individuals after an unencrypted laptop was stolen from an employee's vehicle. HONI agreed to pay $50,000 and implement a corrective action plan to remediate its lack of risk assessments and mobile device policies.
